notes: Structured query templates for the Instagram Insights report, built against the live Instagram Insights (ins) connector schema and validated clean against a live account. ORGANIC ONLY — no paid/spend metrics exist on this connector. Field IDs are raw. Dates NOT stored — runtime resolves from today's date; compare_to_previous queries run twice (current + matching previous window). Instagram is permissive: audience dimensions (age, gender, country, city) combine with each other (validated). DATA NOTES: Story insights are last-24h only (excluded from period reporting). Lifetime metrics (account_followers_count/follows/media) are point-in-time snapshots — use account_new_followers/account_unfollowers/account_growth for period change. Audience demographics are current snapshots, not time-series.

queries.title: Account Insights Totals
queries.note: Period totals — powers the KPI dashboard and growth/engagement headline. Run twice for period-over-period.

queries.title: Lifetime Snapshot
queries.note: Point-in-time current totals (followers, following, posts). Not a period sum — headline only.

queries.title: Weekly Growth & Reach Trend
queries.note: Weekly trend for the growth chart. Use date for daily if a finer line is wanted.

queries.title: Post / Media Performance
queries.note: Per-post performance. media_product_type distinguishes FEED / REELS / etc. Saves + shares are the highest-value signals.

queries.title: Reels Performance
queries.note: Filter to REELS rows in synthesis. Compare Reels reach vs feed reach from media_performance.

queries.title: Audience — Age & Gender
queries.note: Current follower composition by age and gender (validated together). Snapshot, not time-series.

queries.title: Audience — Geography
queries.note: Follower composition by country. Use audience_city for city-level detail.
